title: Cabinet Refinishing in Gainesville, FL Kitchens
description: Cabinet refinishing in Gainesville, FL: degreased, bonded, and sprayed in waterborne urethane enamel. Oak, maple, and thermofoil boxes and doors. Free quote.
heroIntro: Keep the cabinet boxes you already have and give them a hard, smooth enamel finish, without the cost and weeks of mess that come with a full kitchen tear-out.

questions: Is it worth refinishing kitchen cabinets instead of replacing them?
How long will my Gainesville kitchen be out of service?
Can oak cabinets be painted without the grain showing?

body: Cabinet jobs in Gainesville range widely. A kitchen in a NW Gainesville bungalow may have solid wood doors that have been painted once or twice already. Homes from later decades often have golden oak with heavy grain. Newer houses in Haile Plantation or Town of Tioga may have maple or thermofoil doors in a color the owners never chose.

All of them can be refinished, but each needs a different start. Painted wood needs failing layers sanded back; oak may need grain filling if you want a smooth look; thermofoil and slick factory finishes need a bonding primer made for them.

bullets: Doors and drawer fronts removed, labelled, and hardware bagged
Every surface degreased; kitchen grease is the top cause of cabinet paint failure
Scuff-sanded to a tooth and dust removed
Bonding primer suited to oak, maple, or thermofoil
Waterborne urethane enamel, sprayed for a smooth, brush-free finish
Reassembled, adjusted, and checked for alignment; soft-close upgrades on request

sections.h2: Doors in the booth, boxes on site
body: Doors and drawer fronts are finished off site in a dust-free spray booth, which is how they come back without debris in the film. Cabinet boxes, end panels, and face frames are masked and sprayed in place. While doors are away you still have working counters, a sink, and appliances; the cabinets are just open shelving for a few days.

If the boxes are solid, level, and dry, refinishing almost always makes more sense than replacement. If the sink base is swollen from a leak or the layout no longer works, new cabinets may be the better call. Our article refinish vs. replace cabinets lays out the decision, and painting oak cabinets explains how to handle that grain. Choosing a color? Our Gainesville color consultation uses full-size drawdowns, not tiny chips.

sections.h2: Ordering the work with other projects
body: Cabinets are often done alongside a kitchen or whole-house repaint. When both are on the schedule, walls are done first and cabinets last, so the finished enamel is not taped over or scuffed. Ask about bundling it with interior painting in Gainesville on the same estimate, or read more about our cabinet painting and refinishing process. Other work we do around the city is on the Gainesville page.

faqs.q: How long does a cabinet refinishing project take?
faqs.a: It depends on the number of doors and the starting finish. The written estimate includes a schedule so you know how long the kitchen will run without doors.

faqs.q: Will the oak grain show through paint?
faqs.a: It will show some texture unless the grain is filled first. We discuss whether you want grain visible or a smooth look during the walkthrough.

faqs.q: Can you refinish bathroom vanities too?
faqs.a: Yes. Vanities, built-ins, and laundry cabinets get the same degrease, bond, and enamel system as the kitchen.

faqs.q: Can you match an existing cabinet color?
faqs.a: Yes. We can match from a cabinet door, a chip, or a leftover can and show you a drawdown first.
